## Risks
- If the Redis cluster is unavailable, the cache fails open and the catalog is fetched from the backend on every request.
- The cache may not be updated in real-time if the backend is slow to respond.

## Rollback
Revert this pull request and remove the cache configuration. No schema or configuration migration is involved, so the rollback is safe at any time.
